prerequisites: Mastering the material that has been taught

learning_outcomes.text: Comprehension of spoken language as well as lectures in Czech on topics familiar to the student.
Communication with native speakers, participation in discussions.
Ability to write an essay or a report.
Reading and understanding texts concerning currant issues and popular scientific and technical articles.

syllabus_topics: Expressing condition, purpose, cause, reason, consequence, time relations.
Conversation: reading and analysis of technical texts, conversation based on the texts
Technical Czech: CV, applying for a job, interview, presentations, energy
bibliography: Holá, Bořilová: Česky krok za krokem 1, Česky krok za krokem 2
